references.text: Jesus warns against the scribes and Pharisees who perform good deeds to be seen by others, who love the places of honor at feasts and the best seats in the synagogues, and who desire greetings in the marketplaces.
Warning against the scribes who like to walk around in long robes, who crave greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and places of honor at banquets.
Condemnation of those who call evil good and good evil, who exchange light for darkness and bitterness for sweetness.
